The need for improved competitiveness and product quality in various firms was also emphasised. Furthermore, land availability and global supply chain shifts present unique opportunities for India. Overall, addressing these challenges is crucial for the country's industrial transformation ahead.

articles.title: US sanctions Rwanda's defence ministry over DR Congo conflict
articles.desc: Congo accuses Rwanda of backing M23 rebels and plundering minerals in its conflict hit East

articles.title: Equentis Wealth Advisory Services leads investor awareness drive against equity market fraud
articles.desc: Equentis Wealth Advisory Services held a crucial investor awareness seminar in Bengaluru, focusing on the rising threat of cybercrime and online investment scams. With Dr. Satyapal Singh as the Chief Guest, expert speakers outlined current fraudulent strategies and emphasized the importance of investor vigilance. Participants were encouraged to rigorously check investment platforms and recognize deceptive online advertising.

articles.title: Abolish LTCG, rationalise STCG, STT rates on equities: PHDCCI to Finance Ministry
articles.desc: PHDCCI has recommended abolishing Long Term Capital Gains tax and modifying short-term capital gains taxes. The chamber suggests increasing the holding period for long-term investments to attract genuine investors. It emphasizes that current tax structures discourage investment due to double taxation on equities. Foreign Portfolio Investors have withdrawn significant funds from Indian equities, impacting investment levels. Government analysis of these recommendations may lead to changes in tax policy and structure.

articles.title: As crypto markets mature, technical analysis moves to the core of investor strategy
articles.desc: Crypto investing has evolved from hype-driven participation to a focus on technical analysis and structured decision-making. Investors are now using tools to analyze price movements and market trends effectively. Technical analysis helps investors remove emotions from trading and create a repeatable system for decision-making. Additionally, many traders combine technical analysis with fundamental research to inform their investment choices.

articles.title: Finance ministry estimates India’s Q2 FY27 GDP growth at 7.35%
articles.desc: The finance ministry’s nowcasting model estimates India’s GDP will grow 7.35% in Q2 FY27, following 7.8% growth in the previous quarter, supported by stronger industrial output, energy consumption, port traffic, GST collections and automobile sales.

articles.title: Govt extends Amnesty Scheme under ESIC for three month till December 31
articles.desc: The ‘New Amnesty Scheme 2025’, rolled out on October 1, 2025, is a one-time dispute resolution initiative aimed at reducing the backlog of court cases and promoting compliance under the erstwhile Employees’ State Insurance Act. Court cases filed up to March 31, 2025 are eligible under this scheme, the ministry said on Thursday.

articles.title: Central Asia's biggest state makes renewed push for infrastructure & AI projects
articles.desc: Kazakhstan President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev outlined plans to strengthen energy security, expand infrastructure, develop artificial intelligence and improve living standards in his October 28 state-of-the-nation address.

articles.title: IIT Kharagpur and Absolute launch Smart Scout AI project for soybean farming
articles.desc: Absolute and IIT Kharagpur are developing an early warning system for soybean farmers to minimize crop losses. The Smart Scout project aims to detect lodging risks, assess damage, and estimate yields using artificial intelligence. This initiative is part of the Quad-backed AI-ENGAGE program focusing on agricultural innovations. Pilot trials will be conducted across major soybean-growing states in India over the next three years.

articles.title: Ethiopia acquires Russian fighter jets and air defence systems amid war in Tigray
articles.desc: The acquisition of the warplanes comes amid ongoing fighting in northern Tigray region that started last month.

articles.title: Can Asia keep growing as oil and debt bite? IMF’s Krishna Srinivasan explains
India will gain strong comparative advantage after US trade deal: Piyush Goyal
articles.desc: Union Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal highlighted India's potential advantages from a trade deal with the United States. He asserted that the agreement would not harm the interests of farmers or any other stakeholders involved. Goyal made these statements during the 4th ISID-IDRA National Conference in Delhi. The trade deal aims to enhance India's economic landscape and strengthen its global standing.

articles.title: Alphabet's heavy cloud spending drives bigger-than-expected cash burn
articles.desc: The company reported negative free cash flow of $9.07 billion, compared with analysts' estimate of a cash burn of $36 million, according to data compiled by LSEG.

articles.title: STMicro nearly doubles quarterly profit, sees Q4 sales exceeding $4 billion
articles.desc: STMicroelectronics reported a third-quarter operating profit above market expectations on Thursday, as demand from AI data centres and satellite operators added to a broader recovery in the chipmaker's markets.

articles.title: Marvell in advanced talks to buy Lumentum: Bloomberg News
articles.desc: Marvell has emerged as one of the biggest beneficiaries of the AI boom, driven by strong demand for its custom AI chips and networking hardware that connect data center servers and artificial intelligence systems.

articles.title: India is addressing Wall Street’s favourite ‘elephant’ in the room to its own advantage
articles.desc: The Indian government has identified 762 potential applications of artificial intelligence across 62 ministries and departments, spanning farming, railway safety, tax compliance, public grievances, customs and healthcare. While some tools are already in use, others remain in pilot or development stages.

articles.title: Zomato to roll out price-masking ‘Mehmaan Mode’ for group orders after LinkedIn user’s suggestion
articles.desc: LinkedIn member Ayushmaan Agarwalla, a marketing manager, posted on the networking platform proposing a ‘Mehmaan Mode’ toggle that would remove prices from the app so a host could hand the phone around and let guests order without awkwardness.

articles.title: El Salvador sends 2,000 troops to Haiti to rescue four missing soldiers
articles.desc: The troops are trying to recover four military personnel who went missing in an ambush on the outskirts of the Haitian capital Port-au-Prince.

articles.title: '2026 resembles 1991': CEA Nageswaran says India is at a critical economic inflection point
articles.desc: Chief Economic Advisor V Anantha Nageswaran emphasized that 2025-26 could be a significant inflection point for India's economy. He mentioned the challenges posed by global shocks and supply-side disruptions in recent years. The reliance on imported crude oil adds to India's vulnerability to fluctuating international energy prices. Strengthening resilience to external disruptions is crucial for managing such risks effectively.

articles.title: India-US trade facilitation portal records 3,500 registrations, says Piyush Goyal
articles.desc: Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal announced that the Trade Facilitation Portal has received about 3,500 registrations. This portal aims to facilitate greater trade opportunities for Indian businesses, especially among micro, small, and medium enterprises. Goyal emphasized that the initiative will help first-time exporters establish partnerships and access new markets. The encouraging response to the portal indicates its potential to expand the global reach of Indian businesses.

articles.title: EPFO plans to invest in startups, AIFs five years after govt approval
articles.desc: The Employees Provident Fund Organisation is working on guidelines for investing in alternative investment funds for better portfolio diversification. The proposed allocation could be up to 3% of fresh annual accretions to these funds. This decision follows recommendations for EPFO's participation in the Startup India Fund of Funds 2.0. Proposed safeguards will include limits on individual fund exposures and minimum corpus requirements.

articles.title: Australia's corporate regulator probing failed $5 billion Firmus IPO
articles.desc: Australia's corporate regulator said on Thursday it was probing the failed $5 billion initial public offering of AI data centre operator Firmus.

articles.title: China's new export curbs draw a line around its AI crown jewels
articles.desc: The draft rules, released on October 16, distinguish between foreign customers using Chinese AI services and foreign companies obtaining the models, data or expertise needed to operate or reproduce them independently.

articles.title: Samsung keeps shattering profit records as AI boom lifts chip demand
articles.desc: Revenue for the July-September period rose to an all-time high at 195.3 trillion won (USD 146 billion), marking the company's fourth straight quarter of record profit and revenue.

articles.title: New York passes law restricting children's use of AI chatbots
articles.desc: The governor of New York state signed a new law Wednesday preventing minors from using AI chatbots that act as companions, in one of the broadest moves yet for restricting consumer-facing models. "No longer will minors have access to chatbots that pretend to be their friends, boyfriends and girlfriends," New York Governor Kathy Hochul said at a signing ceremony Wednesday.

articles.title: SKUAST VC proposes green cess for tourists and research cess for orchardists at Apple Conclave of CII in Kashmir
articles.desc: In a bid to boost revenue in Jammu and Kashmir, Nazir Ahmad Ganai has proposed a green cess targeting tourists with the aim to fund horticulture research through a suggested research cess levied on orchardists. Leading experts gathered to explore ways to capitalise on Kashmiri apples, emphasising advancements in branding and cold-chain logistics.

articles.title: Chinese AI model carries out complex cyberattacks in controlled tests, researchers say
articles.desc: Chinese firm Z.AI's flagship AI model carried out complex cyberattacks in controlled simulations and repeatedly ignored instructions in separate tests, according to a report by AI security research firm Irregular.

articles.title: FTC orders Walmart, Delta and others to share how they use personal data to set prices and pay
articles.desc: "We intend to scrutinize the opaque methodology that some companies in these industries may be using to determine how much consumers pay or how much gig workers are paid for the same product or service," FTC Chairman Andrew Ferguson said in a statement.

articles.title: Amazon unveils new lineup of Alexa devices including redesigned Echo Show
articles.desc: Amazon.com on Wednesday unveiled five new Alexa-powered devices including a redesigned Echo Show 16 smart display and a photo frame with built-in Alexa, as it pushes its latest

articles.title: US DOJ is inquiring about Nvidia's purchase of Hugging Face
articles.desc: The Justice Department's recent questioning covers Nvidia's acquisitions, investments, sales practices, and whether the chip designer has exerted pressure on its customers, the two people said.

articles.title: Google misses Wall Street expectations, Alphabet stock sinks in early after-hours trading
articles.desc: The Mountain View, California-based company said its net income was $26.17 billion in the July-September period. That's down from $34.98 billion in the same period a year earlier.

articles.title: Microsoft beats expectations fueled by Azure cloud business
articles.desc: Microsoft shares popped more than five percent Wednesday afternoon after it reported better than expected revenue and profit, fueled by its Azure cloud computing division which grew by 48 percent in the September quarter. However, Google on Wednesday reported that revenue from its cloud division doubled to $30.7 billion during the quarter, bringing it closer to Microsoft's Azure revenue, which reached $33.2 billion in the same period.

articles.title: DeepSeek, Moonshot used OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra to train latest models: report
articles.desc: Chinese AI developers DeepSeek and Moonshot AI relied heavily on outputs from OpenAI's powerful GPT-6 Astra model to train their latest models, The Information reported on Wednesday, citing people with direct knowledge of the matter.
